limitations: Every failed/skipped case remains in its original denominator.
Original canonical Windows-junction refusal remains FAIL; supplemental evidence grants no canonical acceptance.
Raw timely packets and hand counts do not establish selected-index or physical accuracy.
Original ReachTiming inferenceCount is a rolling buffer capped400 (src/reach/visualization.ts), not cumulative rawRESULT count or correct position count.

provenance.authorRole: The same agent context implemented the private geometry-bound provider/worker candidate and provider unit tests, then analyzed these terminal browser clocks.
provenance.reviewerIndependence: Separate computation from raw browser clocks does not establish reviewer independence from implementation. Fresh R1 visual review is a separate review role.
provenance.sourceScope: This aggregate remains bound only to its recorded source head/digest/candidate files and cohorts. It is not proof for later UI changes, fingerprints, builds or browser cohorts.
